dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings are visible across the mid-dorsal and lateral regions. These rings exhibit sharp pixel gradients between the dark fur and the light tan perimeters, particularly focused in the central-lateral area where the rings are approximately 2-5% of total body length in diameter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, solid high-intensity tan pixel clusters located on the anterior neck region and scattered across the posterior-most 20% of the visible dorsal area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent 'O' rings in the mid-section form an irregular quadrilateral, while a cluster of three smaller annuli anterior to the mid-section forms a nearly equilateral triangle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-intensity pink bulbous protrusion is visible on the anterior ventral facial region, exhibiting distinct concentric texture folds and a sharp color contrast (R: ~200-255) against the surrounding dark fur.
other_distinctive_markers: The texture topology in the mid-lateral region exhibits a contiguous honeycomb-like lattice where several macro-annuli share boundary edges, creating a networked pattern rather than isolated structures.
